title: Annotatio V §.VI close: Agreed in Fundamentals = already to be / coupled in Consociation — stop before Annotatio VI
pass_a_gloss: But to whom there is agreement with the Fundamentals, this same one, by that very fact that he is to be tolerated, is also to be coupled and has been coupled in the same Ecclesiastical Consociation.
pass_b_english: But whoever does agree with the Fundamentals is, by that very fact that he is tolerable, also to be joined — and already joined — in the same church Consociation.
Stop before Annotatio VI (Classes of controversies among Evangelicals).
source_text: Cui autem convenit cum Fundamentalibus, hic idem eô ipsô, quòd tolerandus, eâdem quoque Ecclesiastica Consociatione copulandus copulatusque est.
